chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa who said: I heard al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying that Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The Divine Authority of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, cannot be established upon His creation except by an Imam until He is recognized.

key_terms.الإمام: Imam — the divinely appointed leader through whom God's authority is established over creation
key_terms.الحجة: Divine Authority/Proof (Hujja) — the authoritative intermediary through whom God's will is made manifest
key_terms.يُعرف: to be recognized/known — referring to the recognition of God through His Imam

ai.seo_question: Why is an Imam necessary for the Divine Authority of God to be established over creation according to Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), as reported through Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), affirms that the divine proof and authority (hujja) of God over His creation is contingent on the presence of an Imam who makes God known and recognizable. This hadith is foundational to the Shia doctrine of Imamate, reflecting the theological principle that God's guidance and authority cannot function in the world without a living, recognized Imam who serves as the intermediary between God and humanity.
